messages:
Lena: FYI APAC-payments flagged invoice INV-9923 from TaroTech (SG) — shows 'VAT 0% / reverse charge' but the UEN on the PDF (123456789A) doesn't match the UEN we have on file (201912345X). Can we still process? cc @mike-tax @ana-apac-fin

Mike: Can you paste the invoice snippet? If vendor intends reverse charge for Singapore, that's unusual — SG uses import GST; we normally self-account if import of services. Need vendor GST reg number and a statement. :eyes:

Lena: Pasting lines from PDF:
```
Invoice INV-9923
Supplier: TaroTech Pte Ltd
GST Reg No: 123456789A
Tax: 0% (Reverse charge claimed)
```
We scanned header; vendor contact says it's their 'billing system' default.

Ana: TaroTech's registered UEN in our PO is 201912345X (TaroTech PTE LTD). 123456789A looks like a legacy number. I'll reach out to the vendor now and ask for a corrected invoice or a formal declaration explaining why 0% applied. Putting on payment hold until reply. (I also flagged to APAC-payments-bot to block release) :white_check_mark:

George (Accounts Payable): Putting INV-9923 on hold in Payable system. We will not send payment until we receive corrected doc or a tax opinion. If they insist on 0% and we can't validate, we may need a credit note and reissue. Any business reason to do a partial payment to preserve 2% early-pay discount?

Priya (CFO): Let's avoid partial payments for tax-sensitive items. Request corrected invoice. If vendor refuses and discount is material, escalate to Treasury — but tax risk not worth accrual error. :no_entry_sign:

Mike: Quick checklist for vendor request:
- Reissued invoice with correct UEN matching their Singapore BizProfile (link: https://www.iras.gov.sg)
- Explicit statement whether this is GST-registered supply, and if they assert 'reverse charge' please provide legal basis
- If export / zero-rated, they must show supporting documents (export docs / service place-of-supply analysis)
I'll paste a short template message you can send.

Lena: Thanks. Sent vendor this template at 10:14 SGT. Vendor replied: "Will reissue within 48h" — TaroTech (accounts@tarotech.com): "Apologies, billing config bug. Reissuing with UEN 201912345X and removing reverse charge." :pray:

Ana: Once reissued, we can proceed with payment. APAC-payments-bot: Please unblock when new invoice is uploaded to the invoice folder.

TaroTech (vendor): Hi Redwood team — confirmed. New invoice INV-9923A uploaded and emailed to lena@redwood.com. Sorry for the confusion.

George (Accounts Payable): Received new PDF. UEN matches. Moving to payment queue. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Lena: Closing thread — thanks everyone.
